content: Elixir v1.19.5 ExUnit formatters are GenServers receiving suite_started/suite_finished and test_started/test_finished events; test.time is in microseconds and suite timing reports run/async/load microseconds. Mix test supports formatter configuration. ExUnit slowest mode activates trace mode and perturbs normal concurrency/timeouts. Official docs/source: hexdocs.pm/mix/1.19.5/Mix.Tasks.Test.html and github.com/elixir-lang/elixir/tree/v1.19.5/lib/ex_unit.
